purpose: What to publish as the 4.42.0 release notes, and where each fact comes from. Paths are relative to the repository root.

publish.use: Render as the release-notes page. Question-shaped headings and the FAQ are written to be quoted on their own; keep them verbatim.
Embed in the page's <script type="application/ld+json">. Set the page's own URL as mainEntityOfPage; the FAQPage answers match the FAQ section of the notes word for word.

link_from_the_page.role: full benchmark report: all 35 categories, wire and pgbench tables, causes
how to reproduce the benchmarks and verify the binaries
every measurement as one JSON document (no file paths, hardware class only)

background_not_for_publication.role: what pg35 is and its history

rules: Numbers in the notes are computed from the benchmark run; do not round further, re-order or recompute them.
Do not add hardware details beyond the hardware class the notes state (architecture, CPU count, memory class).
Slower results are part of the notes; keep the 'What is slower' section and the FAQ answers about it.
